=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- README.md:180 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED` row says "Costs two contents reads per such failed run and no extra sweep read." That claim is wrong when `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` is off or `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` is 0. In those cases the sweep still calls `_pr_base_sync_count`, which makes one `user` read and one paginated comments read for each eligible failed candidate. The relevant code is in `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`: lines 462-473 set `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_OFF=base_sync_disabled` instead of returning, and lines 262-264 and 279 set `sync_off="cap_zero"` and continue.
  WHY: This affects documentation only and nothing fails at runtime. It gives operators a low API-cost figure, and it contradicts the `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` row (README.md:184), the `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX` row (README.md:186) and the changelog "Extra API calls in the sweep" row. All five reviewers rated it NIT, mapped here to low, so there was no severity disagreement. Confidence ranged from 3 to 5.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:line 180, the `FINAL_CI_STALE_WORKFLOW_SYNC_ENABLED` row, which ends with "Costs two contents reads per such failed run and no extra sweep read." | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run edited this row but kept the "no extra sweep read" claim. In scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh, `review_final_ci_sweep_main` (lines 464-472) sets `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_OFF=base_sync_disabled` and runs the candidate loop instead of returning. In `review_final_ci_sweep_base_sync`, a zero cap sets `sync_off="cap_zero"` (lines 262-263) instead of returning early, so execution reaches `_pr_base_sync_count` (line 279), which makes one `user` read and one paginated comments read per eligible failed candidate. Lines 184 and 186 and the changelog.d fragment state the reads correctly, so line 180 is the only contradiction left.
  WHY: This affects documentation only. Operators estimating API cost for `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED=false` or `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_MAX=0` get the wrong figure. Suggested fix: change the text to "and no extra sweep read while base sync is on (see `FINAL_CI_SWEEP_BASE_SYNC_ENABLED` for the reads made when it is off or its cap is 0)".
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE (the reviewer found every deliverable present).
